definitions.gloss: test run; trial run; trial operation
definitions.explanation: Running a machine, vehicle, or system on a trial basis to check its performance before full operation.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{電車|でんしゃ}の{試運転|しうんてん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The test run of the new train has begun.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}の{機械|きかい}を{設置|せっち}した{後|あと}、{試運転|しうんてん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: After installing the factory machinery, we'll conduct a test run.

examples.japanese: {新路線|しんろせん}の{開業|かいぎょう}に{向|む}けて、{数|すう}ヶ{月間|げつかん}{試運転|しうんてん}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して{安全性|あんぜんせい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: In preparation for the opening of the new line, test runs will be repeated over several months to verify safety.

notes:
Composed of {試|し} (trial, test) + {運転|うんてん} (operation, driving). Used for machines, vehicles, factories, and systems. Also used as a suru verb: {試運転|しうんてん}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試運転|しうんてん}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct a test run
- {試運転|しうんてん}を{開始|かいし}する: to begin a test run
- {試運転|しうんてん}{期間|きかん}: trial operation period
- {試運転|しうんてん}{走行|そうこう}: test drive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {試用|しよう}: trial use — for products or software, not vehicles/machines
- テスト{走行|そうこう}: test drive — specifically for vehicles
- {試作|しさく}: prototype, trial production — making a sample product
